notes.title: Dark Crystal: Tactics Patch Notes For March 5
notes.content:
The first post-launch patch for The Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance Tactics is available now!

[list]
[*] Fixed hitching when abilities are first used.
[*] Fixed hitching from placing, removing, and replacing a character.
[*] New Game Plus Improvements and bug fixes.
[*] Added new music to accompany final comic scene.
[*] Added and updated sound effects across UI and abilities.
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]

Thank you for your support!
